choice_prompt:2:1013404001.text: Do you have something on your mind, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>?
choice_prompt:2:1013404001.male: Do you have something on your mind, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>?

say:3:1013404002:1.text: With your meticulous nature, you'd have done it yourself even if I didn't mention it, right?
say:3:1013404002:1.source_cn: 以你缜密的个性，即使我不开口，你自己也会进行确认的，不是吗？
say:3:1013404002:1.male: With your meticulous nature, you'd have done it yourself even if I didn't mention it, right?
say:3:1013404002:1.female: With your meticulous nature, you'd have done it yourself even if I didn't mention it, right?

say:4:1013404003:1.text: I brought it up for a reason... I don't trust Atalanta.
say:4:1013404003:1.source_cn: 我之所以多说这一句……原因很简单。我并不信任阿塔兰忒。

say:5:1013404004:1.text: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, correct me if I'm wrong.
say:5:1013404004:1.male: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, correct me if I'm wrong.
say:5:1013404004:1.female: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, correct me if I'm wrong.

say:6:1013404005:1.text: You seem to have quite a history with her and... even received some of her goodwill.
say:6:1013404005:1.source_cn: 你似乎与那个人早已相识，并且……还接受过她的一些善意。
say:6:1013404005:1.male: You seem to have quite a history with her and... even received some of her goodwill.
say:6:1013404005:1.female: You seem to have quite a history with her and... even received some of her goodwill.

say:7:1013404006:1.text: I trust your judgment, so when you suggested traveling with her, I didn't voice my objections.
say:7:1013404006:1.source_cn: 我相信你对人明察，也相信假以时日，你会自有判断。因此，...
say:7:1013404006:1.male: I trust your judgment, so when you suggested traveling with her, I didn't voice my objections.
say:7:1013404006:1.female: I trust your judgment, so when you suggested traveling with her, I didn't voice my objections.

say:8:1013404007:1.text: But I personally will never trust her—because she has betrayed my trust.
say:8:1013404007:1.source_cn: 但我绝不信任她——因为她曾背叛过我的信任。
